## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run check` passes (sync, validate, tests)
- [ ] New or changed skills use only these frontmatter keys: `name`, `description`, `license`, `compatibility`, `metadata`, `allowed-tools`
- [ ] Skill folder name = `name` in its frontmatter
- [ ] Every claim the skill makes is backed by something it checks (no invented numbers)
- [ ] Scripts have zero dependencies and work on macOS, Linux and Windows
- [ ] Shared code edited in `shared/`, then `npm run sync`
- [ ] No secrets, client data or real customer names in examples
- [ ] Added a test (`tests/`) or an eval case (`plugins/<plugin>/evals/`)
- [ ] Updated `CHANGELOG.md`
